a.title: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved

b.lede: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative.
